tagline: Build a character for Patchwork Paladin's classless, level-less hack of the 5.2 SRD.
blurb: No classes and no levels: you are a background, a species, and a set of ability scores, with a "reference class" borrowed for nothing but its hit die, armor training, shields, and weapon proficiencies. Made for low-level, old-school play, where your wits, your gear, and your contacts matter more than your character sheet.
